title: Parsedmarc: pyasn1 has quadratic-complexity denial of service in binary REAL decoding (CVE-2026-119197)
description: pyasn1 versions up to 0.6.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the decoding of binary-encoded ASN.1 REAL values with large mantissas. The decoding process has quadratic time complexity relative to the mantissa size, causing excessive CPU consumption. This affects BER, CER, and DER decoders that use the shared RealPayloadDecoder. The vulnerability can be triggered when an application decodes attacker-controlled ASN.1 data containing REAL values without proper input restrictions. The issue is fixed in pyasn1 version 0.6.5.
